LanguageData.AMJR_CreateDesc: Draw one rectangular field. Pawns construct the paddy and its bund. Once completed, only rice can be sown inside it; existing growing-zone settings are preserved. Waterworks supplies water automatically when connected.
LanguageData.AMJR_RemoveDesc: Remove the selected paddy plot, leaving the original terrain and existing growing zone unchanged.
LanguageData.AMJR_InvalidRectangle: Select a complete unoccupied rectangle of plantable soil.
LanguageData.AMJR_RiceOnlySow: Only rice may be sown in completed paddies. Remove the paddy or select rice.
